A rose-and-gold nebula blooms softly behind the little planet like a velvet curtain.
Gentle giant stars float nearby, round and warm as lanterns left glowing all night.
A ringed gas-giant looms distant, its pale bands striped with lavender and cream.
Three sibling planets drift in a lazy arc, each one smaller than the last.
The milky-way band curves behind everything, a river of soft spilled light.
Twin pastel moons hang side by side, one blush-pink, one the palest seafoam.
A comet trails its luminous tail in a long slow curve across the dark.
Warm amber sunrise light spills around the planet's edge like honey at dawn.
Aurora-ribbons shimmer through the void in slow waves of teal and violet.
Stardust motes drift like golden pollen through the deep quiet of open space.
A harvest-moon hangs enormous and low, filling half the sky with amber warmth.
Deep indigo starfield stretches endlessly, one bright wishing-star burning at its heart.
Clouds of rose nebula curl in soft wisps, glowing faintly from somewhere within.
A scatter of tiny sibling planets floats like seeds carried away on a breeze.
The milky-way arcs overhead in a gentle powdery sweep of a thousand soft lights.
One great gentle star sits close, warm and steady as a candle through glass.
A second ringed planet drifts far away, its rings tilted like a sleeping eye.
Comet-tails layer one over another, translucent veils of silver crossing the dark.
The horizon of the little sphere glows gold where the light first touches it.
Aurora-ribbons lace between the stars in slow breathing curtains of rose and green.
Loose stardust gathers in drifting pools, softly lit from no particular direction.
Twin moons glow in their different pastels, casting two faint overlapping shadows.
A single bright wishing-star pulses very gently at the centre of the deep blue.
The nebula behind the planet shifts from gold at its heart to deep rose at its edges.
Big gentle stars are scattered wide, each one round and soft as a paper lantern.
